rules.rule: Shared in-memory caches or stores accessed by concurrent request threads must use thread-safe data structures (e.g. ConcurrentHashMap), never plain mutableMapOf() or HashMap.

All feature flag reads (e.g. FeaturesWithFriends / FwF / LaunchDarkly) must have an explicit safe fallback default (e.g. false / default strategy) so network timeouts or unconfigured country tenants do not throw exceptions.
Database queries must always use parameterized bind variables; never use string concatenation or raw string interpolation in SQL / JPQL / HQL queries.
Protobuf contract field tags and enum numbers must never be renumbered or removed. All new fields added to existing message payloads must be optional to preserve backward wire compatibility.

Scheduled cron tasks, Kafka consumers, and external network calls must catch exceptions at the job boundary to prevent pod crash-looping, and must emit error metrics or structured audit logs on failure.
